note: Generated from the register rows that name a layer field. An entry that matches nothing in any fixture fails the second suite. Event types are those of the event catalogue of feature 111 (F111-FR-050); logical names are those of feature 100, annex B §B.5 and annex D §D.8. The texts of DV-016, DV-020 and DV-052 that name these values are proposed upstream in analyze-report.md, "Proposed upstream fixes" (P2, P3).

entries.match: field of the run record and key of the run snapshot

valueNotes.phase:<N>:manifest: the check manifest (annex D §D.8); it holds the record of its derivation (entries[].provenance) and the pins (entries[].pin), which have no logical name of their own
valueNotes.phase:<N>:protected-set: the fingerprints of the protected set at phase entry (F116-FR-004); written when a loop layer or an integrity switch is on, and no integrity switch is on under the parity profile

notReachable.field: the [LOOP] line and the strategy in the status line
notReachable.reason: not printed in compatibility output, which the second suite keeps (F100-FR-179, F100-FR-211); CQ-028

notReachable.field: run:<runId>:task-list, the task list as read at launch (CQ-084 as feature 115 reads it)
notReachable.reason: not a layer field: the engine writes it at launch in every run (annex B §B.5; F115-FR-012), so captures A and B both hold it and compare it; an entry for it would match nothing and fail the suite
